sections.description:
Feuer-Cookie is proprietary WordPress consent and privacy software with service-based blocking, diagnostics and a verified update channel. Use and installation require explicit personal permission from the developer. Repository access or downloading a ZIP does not grant permission.

  • Granular consent by category and service
  • Opt-in consent records without visitor analytics
  • Google Consent Mode v2 support
  • Optional consent bridge for Feuer Analytics
  • Release delivery from wdmin.com with SHA-256 verification

See the included LICENSE.md for full terms.
sections.installation:
Installation and use are permitted only for users who have received explicit personal permission from the developer. A repository clone or ZIP download is not permission.

  1. For authorized use only, upload the plugin folder to wp-content/plugins/feuer-cookie/.
  2. Activate the plugin in WordPress.
  3. Run the diagnostics once and review detected services.
  4. Set privacy, imprint and support links in the plugin settings.
